sloka: दर्शयामास च तदा रावणिं रघुनन्दनः।असम्भ्रान्तो महातेजास्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ।। ६.९१.२४ ।।
transliteration: darśayāmāsa ca tadā rāvaṇiṁ raghunandanaḥ।asambhrānto mahātejāstadadbhutamivābhavat ।। 6.91.24 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Lakshmana, a delight of Raghus, unperturbed, demonstrated to Indrajith, which was a wonder indeed.
